description: This file implements an in-memory grain directory for Orleans testing, managing grain addresses and silos in a concurrent environment.

classes.name: InProcessGrainDirectory
classes.description: An implementation of IGrainDirectory that manages grain locations within an in-process testing environment.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up the address for a given grain ID if the associated silo is not dead.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address, optionally replacing a previous address if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address from the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Removes all grain addresses associated with specified silo addresses.
